findings.highlight: Saber never went easy on me
findings.evidenceJa: やるとなったら本気で手加減なしでやんの
findings.governingReading: Once Saber decides to do it, she becomes completely serious and shows no mercy.
findings.explanation: “Never went easy” loses the switch in Saber’s conduct once she commits and generalizes it into an enduring habit.

findings.evidenceJa: 湿布でベタベタ
findings.governingReading: His bruised body is plastered with compresses or poultice patches.
findings.explanation: The English supplies a specific pain-killing function that 湿布 does not itself state.

findings.evidenceJa: 筋肉痛の追い打ちがあるだろう。
findings.governingReading: Tomorrow muscle soreness will deliver a follow-up blow.
findings.explanation: The prediction remains, but its combat metaphor and separate second wave of pain disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 日課である“強化”の鍛錬
findings.governingReading: his daily routine of training in Strengthening
findings.explanation: mirror moon deletes that this is disciplined daily practice and recasts the training itself as “magic.”

findings.evidenceJa: 少し離れた和室
findings.governingReading: the Japanese-style room a short distance away
findings.explanation: The specific room type is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 今はそれも気にならない。
findings.governingReading: In his exhaustion, even their nearby presence does not register or bother him now.
findings.explanation: “I don’t care” implies indifference toward Saber and Taiga rather than exhaustion eclipsing awareness.

findings.highlight: Thenthis has to be a dream.
findings.evidenceJa: ならこんな事は、やはり夢だ。
findings.governingReading: Then this must indeed be a dream.
findings.explanation: The English visibly fuses “Then” and “this.”

findings.evidenceJa: 足は眠ったままで
findings.governingReading: His legs remain asleep while his body walks.
findings.explanation: The English invites the ordinary idiom of numb feet and narrows 足, weakening the split between sleeping body and moving limbs.

findings.highlight: The wind is blowing on me
findings.evidenceJa: 風は頬を刺して
findings.governingReading: The wind stings or pierces his cheeks.
findings.explanation: A sharp localized sensation becomes generic exposure.

findings.evidenceJa: 体はとっくに冷え切っている。
findings.governingReading: His pajama-clad body has long since become chilled through.
findings.explanation: The completed bodily state and its duration become ongoing freezing.

findings.highlight: my feet are moving toward somewhere.
findings.evidenceJa: 足はしっかりと何処かを目指している。
findings.governingReading: His feet are steadily and purposefully making for some destination.
findings.explanation: The English retains motion but loses the controlled purpose that opposes his conscious will.

findings.evidenceJa: 喉が固まっている
findings.governingReading: His throat has locked up so he cannot scream.
findings.explanation: In the cold setting, “frozen” suggests temperature and obscures magical motor control.

findings.highlight: My limbsthey aren’t following my orders
findings.evidenceJa: 手足は俺衛宮士郎の言う事を聞かず
findings.governingReading: His limbs do not obey Emiya Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English visibly fuses “limbs” and “they.”

findings.evidenceJa: 俺衛宮士郎の言う事を聞かず
findings.governingReading: The source places a body ruby over “Emiya Shirou,” separating the observing self from the controlled body.
findings.explanation: The English conveys disobedient limbs but deletes the marked self/body formulation.

findings.evidenceJa: 石段を登り始め
findings.governingReading: They begin climbing the stone steps.
findings.explanation: The material and the onset of the climb are lost.

findings.evidenceJa: 意識だけが覚醒する。
findings.governingReading: Only his consciousness awakens.
findings.explanation: Dropping だけ weakens the crucial fact that bodily control does not return.

findings.highlight: The only certain thing is my mind.
findings.evidenceJa: 確かなものはこの頭だけ。
findings.governingReading: Only this head remains securely his.
findings.explanation: The abstract “mind” removes the concrete bodily boundary and changes what he can still claim as his own.

findings.evidenceJa: 殺してしまうでしょう？
findings.governingReading: If he comes closer, she may end up killing him—isn’t that so?
findings.explanation: The English removes Caster’s coy, taunting modality and turns it into a flat declaration.

findings.evidenceJa: 嘲りを含んだ微笑。
findings.governingReading: A smile containing mockery.
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes a silent expression into an audible laugh.

findings.evidenceJa: あれだけ止まれと念じた両足
findings.governingReading: the legs he had repeatedly and desperately willed to stop
findings.explanation: The English states their failure but omits Shirou’s sustained conscious resistance.

findings.evidenceJa: 意識が軋む。
findings.governingReading: His consciousness creaks or strains under pressure.
findings.explanation: The mechanical pain image becomes generic uncertainty.

findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァント七人のサーヴァント中
findings.governingReading: a Servant—the heroic spirit most skilled in magecraft among the seven
findings.explanation: The English visibly fuses “Servant” and “a.”

findings.evidenceJa: 最も魔術に長けた英霊
findings.governingReading: the Heroic Spirit most skilled in magecraft
findings.explanation: The work’s technical category 魔術 is generalized to “magic.”

findings.evidenceJa: 私の呪縛を解こう
findings.governingReading: undo or break Caster’s binding
findings.explanation: “Kill” substitutes a different operation and obscures her explanation that expelling energy cannot undo completed magecraft.

findings.evidenceJa: 随分と優しいのね貴方
findings.governingReading: How very gentle or mild of him to try such a lenient method.
findings.explanation: Caster’s elegant, mocking appraisal becomes a generic accusation of naïveté.

findings.evidenceJa: 唯一自由になる意識を総動員して
findings.governingReading: He mobilizes the entirety of the only thing still free: his consciousness.
findings.explanation: The English changes consciousness into will and removes its status as his sole remaining freedom.

findings.highlight: The enemy’s magical energy that’s inside me
findings.evidenceJa: 体内に浸食した、外から混ざった敵の魔力
findings.governingReading: enemy energy that invaded his body and mixed in from outside
findings.explanation: The English retains location but drops both invasion and external admixture, the mechanism he is searching for.

findings.highlight: I identify the flow of magical energy every night.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力の流れ、回路の把握なら毎晩やっている事だ。
findings.governingReading: Every night he maps both the flow of magical energy and his circuits.
findings.explanation: mirror moon deletes circuit mapping from the basis of Shirou’s attempted diagnosis.

findings.highlight: The red spot on my chest has to be Caster’s magical energy.
findings.evidenceJa: 胸についた赤い点はキャスターの魔力なのか。
findings.governingReading: He wonders whether the red point on his chest is Caster’s magical energy.
findings.explanation: A question becomes certainty.

findings.highlight: is taking away my body’s authority.
findings.evidenceJa: 完全に命令権を剥奪されている
findings.governingReading: He has been completely stripped of command authority over his body.
findings.explanation: The English makes the deprivation ongoing rather than complete and makes authority belong to the body rather than Shirou.

findings.evidenceJa: そんなバカな
findings.governingReading: That is impossible.
findings.explanation: The English visibly fuses “No” and “way.”

findings.highlight: the power to repel “magic” such as hypnotism, binding, and coercion.
findings.evidenceJa: 術者の行動を抑制する『魔術』を弾き返す力だ。
findings.governingReading: It repels magecraft that suppresses or constrains the affected practitioner’s actions.
findings.explanation: The examples remain, but the defining relation to suppression of action disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 基礎的な話だ。
findings.governingReading: This is basic or elementary theory.
findings.explanation: The English promotes explanatory background into a universal law.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師とは魔術回路を有する者。
findings.governingReading: A magus is one who possesses Magic Circuits.
findings.explanation: A category-defining statement becomes a one-way property claim.

findings.highlight: it is difficult to interfere with someone with a Magic Circuit
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術回路が働いている内部への干渉は難しく
findings.governingReading: It is difficult to interfere inside a body where Magic Circuits are operating.
findings.explanation: The English drops both the internal target and the circuits’ active state.

findings.highlight: magic is destroyed before it can be completed.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術という式が、完成する前に乱されてしまう
findings.governingReading: The formula constituting the magecraft is disrupted before completion.
findings.explanation: An incomplete formula being thrown into disorder becomes completed “magic” that is destroyed.

findings.highlight: making a weapon in this world and attacking the opponent
findings.evidenceJa: まず外界に要因をつくって、その結果として相手を傷つける
findings.governingReading: first create a causal factor in the external world, which then harms the target
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents a weapon and direct attack, narrowing the source’s general contrast between internal interference and externally mediated harm.

findings.evidenceJa: てっとり早い。
findings.governingReading: The externally mediated approach is quick and expedient.
findings.explanation: Simplicity replaces the tactical advantage of speed and directness.

findings.highlight: magic cast on me from close-range
findings.evidenceJa: ごく間近、密着されての魔術行使
findings.governingReading: magecraft used at point-blank range while in bodily contact
findings.explanation: The English weakens 密着 from contact to mere proximity.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師同士ならば成功する筈のない肉体の乗っ取り
findings.governingReading: bodily takeover that should never succeed between magi
findings.explanation: The English deletes the governing impossibility that makes Caster’s feat terrifying.

findings.highlight: a distance of a few kilometers
findings.evidenceJa: 数キロメートル以上の遠距離
findings.governingReading: a long distance of several kilometers or more
findings.explanation: “A few” removes the lower-bound 以上 and weakens the stated range.

findings.evidenceJa: 貴方たちが編み上げた魔術
findings.governingReading: the magecraft that you people weave into form
findings.explanation: The crafting metaphor and technical category are flattened.

findings.evidenceJa: かける水流が多く激しければ
findings.governingReading: if the applied current of water is both voluminous and violent
findings.explanation: The English omits quantity from Caster’s exception to the liquid/solid analogy.

findings.highlight: The difference between us is that great.
findings.evidenceJa: そういう次元の話なのよ
findings.governingReading: Their difference is on another dimension or plane of comparison.
findings.explanation: A categorical gap in level becomes only a large difference in degree.

findings.evidenceJa: そうかよ。
findings.governingReading: “I see.”
findings.explanation: The English visibly fuses “I” and “see.”

findings.evidenceJa: マスター達はみな小物だけど
findings.governingReading: All the Masters are insignificant small fry.
findings.explanation: The English preserves low ability but drops Caster’s contempt for their stature and worth.

findings.evidenceJa: クスリ、という笑い声。
findings.governingReading: A small audible chuckle.
findings.explanation: An audible vocal reaction becomes a silent expression.

findings.highlight: She shows superiority as if I’m her prey.
findings.evidenceJa: 獲物を前にした優越感しかない。
findings.governingReading: There is nothing in it but the superiority of a predator before captured prey.
findings.explanation: The English weakens exclusivity and makes the prey relation a tentative comparison.

findings.highlight: Don’t lie about wanting to talk to me!
findings.evidenceJa: 何が話をしたくなった、だ。
findings.governingReading: What does she mean, “wanted to talk”?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s internal scornful rejection becomes a direct accusation of deliberate lying.

findings.highlight: I have to let them live
findings.evidenceJa: 殺さない程度に生かし続けて
findings.governingReading: keep them alive continuously, only to the extent of not killing them
findings.explanation: The English loses the prolonged, barely nonlethal exploitation that makes “reassurance” horrific.

findings.highlight: Her laugh echoes in my ears.
findings.evidenceJa: 冷笑が耳朶に響く。
findings.governingReading: Her cold, sneering laugh rings against his ears.
findings.explanation: The sound remains, but its contemptuous quality disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: あの小娘と手を組んだ
findings.governingReading: since he joined forces with that little girl
findings.explanation: The English visibly fuses “girl” and “I.”

findings.evidenceJa: キャスターの唇が、さらに愉快げにつり上がる。
findings.governingReading: Caster’s lips curl still higher in visible delight.
findings.explanation: The specific predatory expression and her pleasure at his ignorance disappear.

findings.highlight: pondering how to kill her prey.
findings.evidenceJa: 捕まえた獲物をどう料理しようか思案するように。
findings.governingReading: as though considering how to prepare or deal with prey she has already caught
findings.explanation: The English literalizes the cooking metaphor as killing, contradicting Caster’s stated plan to keep him alive.

findings.evidenceJa: 貴方たちから身を守る。
findings.governingReading: Caster builds the temple to protect herself from Shirou and his allies.
findings.explanation: The protection remains but its named threat source disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 加減がつかなかった
findings.governingReading: At first Caster could not gauge or calibrate the proper amount.
findings.explanation: “Couldn’t hold back” implies failed restraint or appetite rather than inability to regulate unfamiliar, tiny energy quantities.

findings.highlight: I can collect it pretty well now.
findings.evidenceJa: 今はほどよく集められるわ。
findings.governingReading: Now she can collect it in suitable, moderated amounts.
findings.explanation: Competence “pretty well” loses the contrast in dosage and calibration.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔力の貯蔵
findings.governingReading: the accumulated reserve or store of magical energy
findings.explanation: “Preserved” suggests conservation rather than a stockpile gathered in the land.

findings.evidenceJa: 有象無象の人の欠片
findings.governingReading: fragments of the undistinguished human rabble
findings.explanation: The fragments remain, but Caster’s dehumanizing contempt disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: じゃあ町で起きてる事件は
findings.governingReading: Then the incidents happening in town—
findings.explanation: The English visibly fuses “Then” and “the.”

findings.evidenceJa: 下界で蠢く人間たち
findings.governingReading: the humans crawling or writhing in the world below
findings.explanation: Caster’s divine pretension and dehumanizing image disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 千にいたる人の輝き
findings.governingReading: the radiance of a number of people reaching toward a thousand
findings.explanation: mirror moon reverses the magnitude: approaching or reaching a thousand becomes exceeding it.

findings.highlight: Caster’s standing there as if to make fun of me.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺を嘲笑うキャスター
findings.governingReading: Caster stands there openly mocking him.
findings.explanation: The English weakens stated mockery into an “as if” comparison.

findings.evidenceJa: 同時に今まで見えなかった敵の姿
findings.governingReading: At the same time, the enemy’s previously unseen figure
findings.explanation: The English visibly fuses “same time” and “the.”

findings.highlight: I shall take that Command Spell from you.
findings.evidenceJa: その令呪を貰ってあげるわ。
findings.governingReading: Caster condescendingly offers to take his Command Spell off his hands.
findings.explanation: The transfer remains, but 貰ってあげる’s patronizing benefactive voice disappears.

findings.highlight: Saber is too valuable to have disappear.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは消すには惜しいサーヴァント
findings.governingReading: Saber is too valuable a Servant for Caster to erase or destroy.
findings.explanation: The English makes disappearance intransitive and removes Caster as the potential destroyer.

findings.evidenceJa: まずはその皮を剥いで
findings.governingReading: First Caster will flay the skin, then transplant the Command Spell.
findings.explanation: The mature English branch replaces skin flaying with an unsupported arm amputation.

findings.highlight: taking out your nerves as well.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方から魔術回路を引き抜く
findings.governingReading: She will pull out Shirou’s Magic Circuits, read by the ruby as his nerves.
findings.explanation: The English keeps only the ruby-level anatomy and deletes the base-text occult mechanism.

findings.highlight: cut off my arm and take all the nerves in my body with it?
findings.evidenceJa: 体の中に張り巡らされた神経を持っていくっていうのか。
findings.governingReading: She will take the nerves spread throughout his body.
findings.explanation: The English adds arm amputation again and creates the unsupported claim that every bodily nerve leaves with the arm.

findings.evidenceJa: 正常ではいられなくなるでしょうね。
findings.governingReading: He will no longer remain in a normal functional state.
findings.explanation: The mature English branch substitutes the much more specific and dehumanizing “vegetable.”

findings.highlight: I desperately put power into my limbs
findings.evidenceJa: 手足がバラバラになってもいいと力を込める
findings.governingReading: He strains with desperate force, willing to let his limbs tear apart.
findings.explanation: The English omits the self-destructive extent of Shirou’s resistance.

findings.highlight: The glowing fingers reach out for my left hand like a crawling spider
findings.evidenceJa: 禍々しい光を帯びた指が、這い寄る蜘蛛のように、ゆっくりと俺の左手に伸びて
findings.governingReading: Fingers carrying an ominous light slowly reach toward his left hand like a creeping spider.
findings.explanation: The English retains the spider image but drops both the malign quality of the light and the threatening slowness.
